messages.subject: Kingsmoor House - Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Marcus,

Our report on title attached. Headline: good and marketable, recommend proceeding. Points to note: (1) break/expiry profile 2027-28 (Brookmere and Meridian breaks, two short 5th-floor lettings) - relevant to your asset management plan; (2) the Aldermere rent review is open and dealt with by a £45k retention; (3) we need your VAT registration and option to tax confirmed for TOGC; and (4) SDLT of £697,000 at the revised £14.15m price. Happy to talk it through.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
